data.name: Willow
data.gender_notes: Willow is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English welig, 'willow tree'. Its root is Old English welig. A modern English given name. Willow is a English name meaning “Willow tree”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Willow expresses “Willow tree”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old English welig, 'willow tree'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Willow total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
